title: 🌊 Wavy Particle Flow with JavaScript Canvas 🖱️
description:
I’ve built a mesmerizing Wavy Particle Flow using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! This project creates a series of wave-like patterns made of glowing blue circles that ripple across the screen, reacting to your mouse with a subtle push effect. It’s a blend of math and interactivity that looks stunning! ✨

  • What’s it about? Waves of particles move in a sinusoidal pattern, shifting with perspective and distorting near the mouse cursor.

  • The result? A fluid, wave-like animation that feels dynamic and responsive.

  • Main key of the code: The animate function uses Math.sin for wave motion and calculates mouse-driven offsets, while perspective scaling adds depth.

  • How can users benefit? Perfect as a unique background, tweak wave count, amplitude, or colors to fit your project, or study it for wave-based animations!
shortDescription: 💧 Waves of particles ripple and react to your mouse, crafted with JS Canvas. Ideal for fluid visuals!
